app.name: Swiss departures
app.summary: Live departures from any Swiss stop, or every connection from A to B, with delays and platforms.
app.stop_hint: Type a few letters of the station or stop, such as "Zürich HB" or "Bern, Bahnhof", and pick it.
app.kind_hint: Show only trains, trams, buses, boats or cable cars. All shows everything.
app.line_hint: Choose a stop first. Empty shows every line that leaves here.
app.towards_hint: Choose a stop first. Only departures whose last stop is this place; empty shows both directions.
app.walk_hint: Departures you can no longer make are skipped, and the tile says when to leave ("Leave in 3 min", "Leave now").
app.late_hint: A departure that runs a minute or more late gets "+2'" behind where it goes.
app.track_hint: The platform (Pl. 7) or stand (Stand D), and the new one when it changed.
app.trip_to_hint: Where you are going. Every train that takes you there shows, also one that runs on beyond it (the IC 5 to Rorschach for Zürich HB).
app.direct_hint: Leave out connections with a change.
app.look_hint: Tessera's blue, red line badges as on Swiss station boards, or a dark station board.
app.kinds_hint: Trains red, trams and metros blue, buses yellow, boats purple, cable cars green.
app.alarm: Colour when it's time to leave
app.alarm_hint: Needs a walk to the stop. The tile turns orange in the minute you should set off.
